No active claim of full macOS gateway capability is permitted until native peer traffic, IPv4 NAT/IPv6 forwarding, crash/restart, foreign-state preservation, and service/installer qualification are demonstrated on supported targets. Apple's TN3165 PF guidance requires a separate affirmative support/distribution decision; unsupported or unqualified gateway mode MUST fail closed.
